name: Blue Flowers
description: Bluebells in patches across Taiga and Tundra, as dandelions grow in warmer land. Placed and picked like the rose and dandelion; a bluebell makes light blue dye, and bonemeal on grass in those biomes can grow one. It also calls beta's yellow flower Dandelion, where beta said Flower, with a switch in its settings to keep Flower.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
